Long_Balancing_Cheetah_Tail.description: Adorned with sleek fur and adorned with distinctive black spots, the Long Balancing Cheetah Tail serves as an extension of grace and poise, enhancing agility and speed while granting the user the ability to perform acrobatic maneuvers with unmatched precision and flair.

Prehensile_Grasping_Margay_Tail.description: The margay's tail, a marvel of nature’s engineering, is not merely a feline appendage but a prehensile tool that grants unparalleled dexterity and agility, allowing the creature to traverse treacherous heights with the grace and precision of a spider, its tail acting as a fifth limb to secure and manipulate its surroundings.

Thick_Tufted_Lion_Tail.description: A majestic, thick tufted lion tail, adorned with regal golden fur and a bushy black tip, not only commands attention with its sheer presence but also imbues its bearer with the charisma and strength of a true lion, granting them the ability to rally allies and intimidate foes.

Swishing_Panther_Shadow_Tail.description: The Swishing_Panther_Shadow_Tail is a sleek, elongated appendage that undulates with silent grace, enhancing its bearer's feline agility and stealth, while granting them the skills to vanish into the shadows and strike with deadly precision from the blind spot of their foes.

Short_Bobbed_Lynx_Tail.description: A short, bobbed lynx tail, tipped with frost and flicking with feline grace, enhances its bearer's agility and constitution, granting them the uncanny ability to traverse rugged terrain with ease, leaving no trace of their passage.

Aquatic_Rudder_Fishing_Cat_Tail.description: This sleek aquatic tail, a graceful appendage adapted for the feline form of a fishing cat, enhances agility and swimming speed, granting the user the ability to perform a swift Swim Dash through water with effortless grace.

Cybernetic_Whip_Antenna_Tail.description: This feline-inspired cybernetic tail, with its sleek, whip-like antenna, enhances agility and sensory acuity, granting its bearer the ability to strike with precision and induce bleeding, while also locking onto targets with eerie accuracy.

Fluffy_Pallas_Cat_Wrap_Tail.description: This luxurious, fluffy tail, reminiscent of a Pallas cat, not only serves as a comforting companion in the chilliest of realms but also enhances one's resilience and charisma, granting the wielder the ability to resist the biting cold and aiding in minor regenerative efforts.

Ethereal_Smoky_Ghost_Tail.description: This ghostly, smoky tail, resembling a feline appendage, trails behind the bearer, granting an otherworldly aura that enhances their stealth and wisdom, while bestowing the abilities to see through the veil of the living and blend into the spectral realm.

Spiked_Mace_Saber_Cat_Tail.description: This formidable spiked mace saber cat tail, a fearsome appendage of a smilodon, is a testament to raw strength and ferocity, its heavy, spiked tip capable of devastating blows that can knock down even the mightiest foes, though its bulk slightly hinders the agility of its bearer.
